kebab_example: aliyun eas delete-service --cluster-id cn-shanghai --service-name foo --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteService

parameters.help_en: The region where the service is located. For example, the region ID for China (Shanghai) is cn-shanghai
parameters.help_zh: 服务所在区域。例如华东2（上海）为cn-shanghai
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the service. For more information about how to view the service name, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/412109.html
parameters.help_zh: 服务名称。如何查看服务名称，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/412109.html
parameters.name: service_name

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run on the request.

true: performs a dry run without executing the actual operation. If the dry run fails, the corresponding error is returned. If the dry run succeeds, the error code DryRunOperation is returned.

false (default): sends a normal request
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。

true：发送检查请求，不会真正执行操作。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码 DryRunOperation。

false（默认）：发送正常请求
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性
parameters.name: client_token

Message.description_en: The message returned in the response
